status: PROPOSED TEST DESIGNS, NOT RUN. Not a native scheduler, external effect transaction or certified rollback guarantee.
conditions: Each provider ticket is bound to verified graph/source/lock, operation identity, exact owner/generation, side-effect policy and live capability. UI task-slot finality is separate from provider native resource quiescence.

cases.scenario: bad typed argument, no ticket, live slot
cases.reason: No provider Result and no effect

cases.scenario: result queue capacity cannot be reserved, no ticket
cases.reason: Never dispatch, retain caller input ownership

cases.scenario: target or capability invalid before provider acceptance
provider unavailable and absence of dispatch is proven
operation admitted, provider link lost, no terminal/quiescence proof
cases.reason: UI slot may settle with uncertainty while provider resources remain owned

cases.scenario: indeterminate result delivered, late provider success later
cases.reason: Never publish second UI TaskOutcome; preserve evidence/cleanup and no implicit replay

cases.scenario: provider result Success(T) linearized before link loss
cases.reason: Later transport loss cannot overwrite verified terminal

cases.scenario: provider Result Failure(E) linearized before link loss
cases.reason: Failure payload is exact provider error, never ProviderError category

cases.scenario: user requests cancellation, provider has not confirmed quiescence
cases.reason: No Cancelled TaskOutcome from request alone

cases.scenario: provider success wins race with cancel request
cases.reason: One terminal UI outcome, preserve actual provider success

cases.scenario: verified quiescence wins before any successful/failed provider result
cases.reason: Proof binds exact ticket, owner and generation

cases.scenario: view unmounts after dispatch but provider is not yet quiescent
cases.reason: Stale view handler must not run, provider buffer remains owned

cases.scenario: restart after unknown external effect, without idempotency contract
cases.reason: Snapshot recovery must not redispatch external operation

cases.scenario: indeterminate after dispatch and UI ingress is full
cases.reason: No drop, extra effect, fake provider failure or unbounded queue

cases.scenario: fake cancellation confirmation from untrusted UI callback
cases.reason: Only trusted provider/runtime may attest quiescence

cases.scenario: late completion ticket belongs to a replaced view generation
cases.reason: Old generation cannot mutate replacement state
